title: Fixed Raised Split Cap and Through Sleeve Bearing Housing
description: One wholly newly authored complete split-bearing-housing display in a fixed partly opened pose. A broad continuous grounded mounting foot has two actual bounded mounting windows. A whole lower semicircular thick saddle and its two side ears are rooted in that foot. A separate complete upper semicircular cap with full side ears stays visibly raised on two retained long studs and lower collars, with independent proud top nuts. One whole bronze-looking through sleeve remains seated in the lower saddle with its full empty axial bore open. The raised cap is held by visible studs and collars, not an unsupported exploded loose part. Unlike a complete ball bearing, there are no rolling balls, grooved races or pocket cage; unlike an old coupling display support sleeve, the whole structure is a two-ear footed split housing with independently retained raised cap. No old bearing, shaft or support component imported or extracted. Three opaque solid PBR roles, metres Z up and full bounds-centred ground datum, one whole model zero scenes. Fixed static illustrative mechanical exterior only: no shaft, motion, lubrication, alignment, tolerances, installation fit, clamping, load, manufacture, maintenance procedure or safety capability. Rigging animation and interaction not made.
